selection_rate_before: 0% (denominator = misses; original pipeline selected none by construction)
quantamm_control: P184/P186 = 7/9 selected (reused, not re-run); excluded from headline per spec
decision_basis: Selection improvement (>=1 SELECTED) appears in 3 of 4 measured architectures (zaros, revert-lend, panoptic) spanning perps/lending/options — architecturally distinct from quantamm's Balancer hooks; false_carry=0. Gains are NOT concentrated in quantamm-like systems. Caveats: modest absolute selection rate; a meaningful fraction is HARNESS_BOUND (2/13 NEEDS_HARNESS); 2 zaros items were sibling-traced (locus-routing limitation, not adjudication); blind outputs carry high mechanism volume (precision watch, though 0 clearly-unsupported carries).
dominant_remaining_failure_mode: Two-layered: (1) UPSTREAM coverage/locus-routing — at corpus level only ~40-60% of misses were ever deep-run (rest never traced = discovery gap), and within the sample 2 items traced the wrong sibling of a multi-function locus; (2) specific-mechanism miss — on correctly-traced functions the deep-trace enumerates plausible mechanisms but not the exact subtle awarded one (panoptic H-03 zero-premium skip, M-03 wrong destructure order, ark non-receiver revert). Adjudication is no longer the sole bottleneck; coverage + specific-mechanism recall now dominate.
selection_rule: Per corpus: from DEEP_RUN_BUT_MISSED take <=4, High->Medium, function-level locus first. Pre-registered before any blind output was scored.
